title: Have a certified forest practices plan before harvesting or clearing
what: Establish forests, harvest timber or clear trees on land only while a certified forest practices plan authorising the activity is in place for that land.

sources.title: Forest Practices Act 1985 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person who is a responsible person in relation to any land must not carry out, or cause or allow the carrying out of, an activity of the following kind on that land unless a certified forest practices plan authorising the carrying out of the activity exists in respect of that land when that activity is being carried out: (a) the establishment of forests; (b) the harvesting of timber

sources.title: Forest Practices Act 1985 (Tas)
sources.locator: s 3, words naming the body (found 20 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: Authority means the Forest Practices Authority;

reach.condition: if it establishes forests, harvests timber or clears trees on land in Tasmania
